abilities.name: Inner Flame

evidence.quote: Active: Karma fires a bolt in the target direction that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds.

notes: Spell shield will block the initial impact from Inner Flame.
Inner Flame's effect radius is centered around the location of the missile as it collides.

abilities.name: Soulflare

evidence.quote: The explosion creates a field for 1.5 seconds that slows enemies within by 50%, which then ruptures to deal magic damage.

notes: Spell shield will block the initial impact from either ability but will not block Soulflare's field damage.
Soulflare's detonation radius is centered around the location of the missile as it collides, while the lingering field will always be created at the impacted enemy's center instead.

abilities.name: Focused Resolve

evidence.quote: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is dealt the same magic damage again and is rooted for a duration, during which they are revealed.

applies.condition: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is dealt the same magic damage again and is rooted for a duration, during which they are revealed.

notes: Spell shield will block the tether's application and damage but not the aftereffects of one already applied.

If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on cooldown nor pay its cost.
  - If they move too far away during the cast time, however, the ability will cancel as normal but still go on cooldown and pay its cost.
    - Summon Aery will still count as the target being damaged this way.

abilities.name: Renewal

evidence.quote: Mantra Bonus: Focused Resolve's root duration is increased.
Karma heals for 17% (+ 1% per 100 AP) of her missing health once on-cast, and again once the tether lasts its full duration or the target dies while tethered.

notes: Spell shield will block the tether's application and damage but not the aftereffects of one already applied.

If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on cooldown nor pay its cost.
  - If they move too far away during the cast time, however, the ability will cancel as normal but still go on cooldown and pay its cost.
    - Karma is still healed on-cast.
    - Summon Aery will still count as the target being damaged this way.
